items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: I was a member of the young tuxedo band, but I was considered a member of that band because most of the time, if Johnny wouldn't make a job, I'd work with that band, you see.

ctx.x: Johnny Bebe. Abbey for Johnny. Oh, yeah.
How come the Johnny wasn't on the record?
